, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread Britannica’s result and recorded Ibn Arabi’s birth year as 1965 instead of 1165. This data extraction/reading error would directly invert the comparison with Mahbub ul Haq (1934), potentially yielding the wrong conclusion about who was born first, though it was corrected later.
